description:
`DocFormatAdapter::rewrite_links` defaults to `unimplemented!()`. No adapter overrides it and nothing calls it.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/document/adapter.rs:48-50` declares `rewrite_links` with an `unimplemented!()` body (`:49`). It is the only `unimplemented!` or `todo!` in workspace Rust. `HtmlAdapter`, `MarkdownAdapter` and the feature-gated parser adapters (`document/mod.rs:29,31`) do not override it. The trait doc (`adapter.rs:12`) mentions "asset scanning and link rewriting", and the method doc is at `:44-47`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `DocFormatAdapter` declares no link-rewrite method, and library code contains no `unimplemented!()`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The trait doc does not mention link rewriting.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every adapter, including those behind the `html` and `xml` features, compiles.
title: Remove the unimplemented link-rewrite adapter method
